ios.desc:
Discover the world's hidden gems through play.

Whether you're a local exploring your own backyard or a visitor discovering new sights, Strollhunt transforms your leisurely stroll into a thrilling adventure.

Strollhunt is currently available in a select number of cities, with more being added all the time. If your city isn’t available yet and you’d love to bring it to life, we’d love to hear from you!

Here's how it works:

- Walk through the city on the hunt for the hidden gems hinted at in the clues.
- Play the city by snapping the real world with our 'Magic Camera', checking in at places with our 'Magic Radar', or solving challenges with our 'Q&A'.
- Learn about the cultural or historical significance of the hidden gems you uncover.
- Collect all the hidden gems in the city, earn a medal and challenge your friends to see who knows the city best. 
- Discover cool spots recommended by people who know the city best.
 
Get ready to Strollhunt!

Notes

This app is free to play, with optional in-app purchases. It is optimized for smartphones, not tablets.
An internet connection and Location Services (with Precise Location enabled) are required. 
Camera access is needed for the Magic Camera feature.
Compatible with iPhone devices running iOS 18 or later. Compatibility with all devices is not guaranteed.

Questions, thoughts, or feedback? Reach us at lucas@strollhunt.com

With love, the Strollhunt team

Discover the world's hidden gems through play. Whether you're a local exploring your own backyard or a visitor discovering new sights, Strollhunt transforms your leisurely stroll into a thrilling adventure.

Strollhunt is currently is available in a select number of cities, with more being added all the time. If your city isn't available yet and you'd love to bring it to life, we'd love to hear from you.

Here's how it works:

- Walk through the city on the hunt for the hidden gems hinted at in the clues.
- Play the city by snapping the real world with our 'Magic Camera', checking in at places with our 'Magic Radar', or solving challenges with our 'Q&A'.

- Because Strollhunt is a game played in the real world, you need to be connected to a network in order to use the app.

- You need to 'Allow Strollhunt to take pictures and record video' to make full use of the app.
- Compatibility information may be changed at any time.
- Compatible with devices with Android Version 12.0 or later installed.
- Compatibility not guaranteed on all Android devices.
- Information current as of July 5, 2026.

quotes.text:
Strollhunt: Walk, Play, Learn is a free mobile app to find and create games to play in the real world.

It’s the fun of Pokémon Go, plus you learn about the city by playing. Strollhunt is for visitors and locals alike. You can play in 50+ cities around the world and growing (SF, NYC, Seattle, London, Paris, Barcelona, Berlin, Tokyo, etc.) on iPhone, and starting today on Android. Please accept my apologies if you download Strollhunt and we're not available to play in your city, the world is big and we have very limited resources, but you can add your city to the Strollhunt Platform by creating new points of interest to discover through play straight from the app. Indeed, Strollhunt is also a no-code Augmented Reality platform, so if you're interested in creating an immersive experience at any outdoor location in the world, Strollhunt can help you do just that.

What is Strollhunt in 20 seconds: https://youtu.be/kwZFRZ5HpV4

Get Strollhunt for iPhone: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/strollhunt-walk-play-learn/id1525189730

Get Strollhunt for Android (launched just today on the Play Store and on Product Hunt): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.strollhuntltd.strollhunt

I'd love to get your feedback on your experience trying Strollhunt in your city. If you encounter any irregularities in the look and feel of the app, or if you stumble upon any aspect that seems ambiguous or could benefit from enhancement, please let me know in comments or by tapping the 'Contact …
